# Evolix Studio
> Digital Agency for Website Development, Branding, Custom Software, Amazon A+ Content, Product Photography, and Digital Marketing.

## About
Evolix Studio is a modern digital agency engineering high-performance websites, custom software, ERPs, brand systems, and performance marketing campaigns for growing companies.

- [Home](https://evolix-studio.in/): Overview of agency capabilities, interactive services wheel, and featured client work.
- [Services](https://evolix-studio.in/services): Detailed scope and deliverables across Web Development, Branding & Identity, Amazon A+ Content, Product Photography, Custom Software, and Digital Marketing.
- [Work](https://evolix-studio.in/work): Selected client case studies including Indian Remedies, Krishna Tools, Nagarwala, Evolix CRM, Shield Max, and Arcadia.
- [Contact](https://evolix-studio.in/contact): Discovery intake form and project inquiries.
